Do not record this dose on the phone: record it in the paper controlled drugs register and on the paper MAR, with a witness, and tell the nurse in charge. If this home has moved to Thapsus Care's register since, connect to the internet and open the dose again.
mobile.meds.cdRecordingUnknown: This phone has not checked which controlled drugs register this home uses. Connect to the internet and open the dose again. If you cannot, do not give it until the nurse in charge confirms which register to use.
mobile.meds.cdWitnessRequired: A second member of staff must witness this dose. This home does not allow a controlled drug to be recorded without a witness.
mobile.meds.cdWitnessRulesUnknown: This phone does not know this home's witness rules yet, so a second member of staff must witness. If no one can, do not give it alone: contact the nurse in charge or the person on call.
mobile.meds.conflictCdOnWeb: {reason, select, cd {This is a controlled drug.} other {This medicine is not on this phone.}} Decide which record is right in Thapsus Care on the web, where you will be asked to confirm it is you.
